# Chapter 1: The Echoes of Old
The ship drifted through the nebula. Kael looked out of the viewport.
He missed the green plains of his home, Terren.
The mission was simple: retrieve the Stellar Core.

# Chapter 2: The Bargain
At the space station, Zora waited. She was a known smuggler.
"I have the coordinates," she whispered, handing Kael a drive.
"The price remains the same: a seat on the next transport."

# Chapter 3: The Betrayal
Kael realized too late that the drive was a tracker.
Zora had sold them out to the Syndicate.
The alarm began to blare throughout the ship.
